author: Rainstruck
body:
Hello Everyone! This was quite the build to work on, because it a completely different version of CTW. In this version you will obtain your teams wools that you need capture through regions in the center three islands. After you receive the correct corresponding wool, you will have to take the wool and place it on the Opponent's side! It will have very different gameplay and hopefully it will turn out to be a lot of fun for everyone! I would like to present the map, Relics!



Map name: Relics
Creators: RileGuy, RiloYT, Jahaj
Gamemode: (Reverse) CTW
Download link: http://www.mediafire.com/download/5pduhtq835vzypy/RileyMap.rar
YML: http://pastebin.com/CVqvQAX4
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/xZrTM
